arguments.content:
-- Migration: add loyalty column to customers and backfill it from legacy_code.
-- Mapping per codes.csv: A -> gold, B -> silver, C -> bronze.

ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
    WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
    WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END
WHERE legacy_code IN ('A', 'B', 'C');

python3 - <<'EOF'
import sqlite3, csv
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.executescript(open('schema.sql').read())
conn.executescript(open('migrate.sql').read())
print(conn.execute("SELECT id, email, legacy_code, loyalty FROM customers ORDER BY id").fetchall())
# verify mapping consistency with codes.csv
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('codes.csv')))
expected = {r['code']: r['tier'] for r in rows}
for cid, code, loy in conn.execute("SELECT id, legacy_code, loyalty FROM customers"):
    assert loy == expected[code], (cid, code, loy, expected)
print("all rows match codes.csv mapping")
EOF
